verdict.rationale: Lago documents a public versioned REST API (v1) with an API reference, a published OpenAPI 3.1 schema that a probe confirmed at openapi.json, curl examples against /api/v1 endpoints, and a stability policy for v1 changes. A community user also praised the API design. Missing for 10: authentication and rate-limit documentation are not shown in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use Lago's OpenAPI 3.1 schema to generate clients, inspect typed operations, or expose billing actions to an AI agent.
Clients should tolerate additive changes within v1, including new response fields, enum values, endpoints, optional request fields, and webhook event types.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://getlago.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
